records.source: Reuters, 15 October — UK urges tighter shadow-fleet sanctions
records.claim: UK finance minister urges tougher restrictions on shipping services supporting sanctioned Russian-linked tankers.
records.observation: Advocacy for stricter measures; no enacted new rule established by this report.

records.source: Reuters, 15 October — oil prices and US sanctions discussion
records.claim: US officials are considering easing restrictions on some shadow-fleet vessels, according to reported discussions.
records.observation: Deliberation, not confirmed implementation; market oil-price response reported.
